_comment: BYS360 coverage ratchet baseline. Truthful, re-measured floor for CI's actual test scope (tests/quality -m ci_safe, then tests/integration tests/architecture tests/security tests/critical, branch=true). This value is NOT aspirational and must NEVER be raised automatically by any script -- raising it is a separate, human-reviewed action after real coverage genuinely improves. See scripts/quality/bys360_coverage_ratchet.py for enforcement logic and scripts/quality/bys360_coverage_ratchet.py docstring for the no-self-raise constraint.

environment.os: Windows 11 (worktree measurement; CI runner is ubuntu-latest -- see tolerance note in ratchet script)

commands: python -m pytest tests/integration tests/architecture tests/security tests/critical --cov=app --cov-append --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:reports/quality/coverage.xml --cov-fail-under=0 --tb=short -q
tolerance_rationale: Absorbs float rounding and Windows-worktree-vs-Ubuntu-CI-runner platform noise (this baseline was measured on Windows; the actual CI runner is ubuntu-latest, which can take slightly different code paths on OS-conditional branches). Not intended to absorb a real coverage regression, which is expected to be much larger than 0.5 points in practice.
